about: Fifteen Days coverage, the cafe close-ups that replace the over-the-shoulder shots over Deluin (they drew him twice in nine tries). DRAFTED prompts.

Keep reference image 1's exact framing and crop: the same close-up, nothing added outside its edges, never widen the view. Every mouth is closed, lips together: smiles and laughs are small closed-lip smiles, no teeth visible at all, never a grin. Faces stay soft and natural. Each main person's face, hair, skin and clothes match their reference exactly. In this frame: the slim young man is turned three-quarters, looking toward the right of the frame, never straight at the camera. No robot and no other people anywhere in the picture. Exactly one main person, appearing once. Nobody else in the picture at all: no other diners, no passers-by, no figures in the windows. Everyone stands on the ground or sits on a chair at their real size: nobody floats, nobody sits or stands on a table. Detailed science fiction comic art at night: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, a deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, clear readable faces and hands. Wherever the sky shows, enormous megastructures and towering buildings fill the far distance and the horizon, their lit windows and beacons glowing against the night, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance. Another time and place, not the Earth we know: unfamiliar architecture, no recognisable landmarks, vehicles or brands.
